selection_approach_display: Applicants are assessed using the university's published selection score.

university.name: Hull York Medical School
university.institution_type: Joint medical school of the University of Hull and University of York

course.name: MB BS Medicine
course.notes: Graduates apply to the same A100 route. HYMS's separate six-year Gateway Year course is A108 and is outside this profile.

applicant_pools.name: Home UK school-leavers
applicant_pools.notes: Official contextual eligibility and the unofficial estimate tariff are reported separately.

applicant_pools.name: Graduate applicants to A100
applicant_pools.notes: No separate graduate quota or ranking pool is officially published.

overall_policy.description: Published GCSE, A-level, IB, Scottish, graduate, UCAT, SJT, IELTS, age, transfer and supported resit rules are executable. Unlisted country-specific qualifications require HYMS equivalence review.
manual_review_if: A country-specific international qualification has not been verified by HYMS.
An unsupported qualification route or incomplete resit history is supplied.

gcse.achieved_or_predicted: Achieved grades are scored; applicants may be working towards the English Language and Mathematics minimums.
gcse.scoring_role: The best six GCSE results contribute up to 35 points to the official selection framework.
gcse.notes: No separate GCSE Biology or Chemistry requirement is published.

a_level.third_subject_rules: Any third subject except the published exclusions.
a_level.sitting_policy: The three A levels must be studied and awarded concurrently in one sitting.
a_level.science_practical_endorsement: No separate practical-endorsement requirement was stated in the supplied official research; it is not inferred.
a_level.notes: Reduced AAB and alternative ABB contextual grades are offer-stage policies and do not replace the standard pre-interview eligibility gate in estimate mode.

ib.notes: A repeated Year 13 equivalent requires at least 31 points and 5,5,5 at Higher Level at first sitting.

higher_offer.notes: Used with the applicable Advanced Higher route.

advanced_higher_offer.notes: Biology and Chemistry are required at Advanced Higher. An alternative AAAAA Higher plus AA Advanced Higher Biology and Chemistry route is accepted.

scottish.notes: Repeated S6 requires at least BC in Advanced Higher Biology and Chemistry at first sitting.

degree.additional_requirement: Three distinct A levels at BBB in the first sitting.
degree.notes: Graduates apply through A100 and do not receive contextual selection points.

international.automatic_scope: A-level, IB, or a qualification explicitly marked as verified by HYMS in applicant evidence.

post_16.notes: Unlisted and unverified qualification equivalence is never inferred.

ucat.ranking_method: UCAT cognitive total converted to decile, worth up to 35 points.
ucat.notes: HYMS publishes no fixed raw UCAT cut-off.

sjt.notes: SJT is both an eligibility gate and a scored component.

conditions: Repeating Year 13 requires at least BBB at the initial sitting.
Adding Biology or Chemistry after the first sitting requires initial AAA with AA in Biology and Chemistry and completion within one year.
IB repeat applicants require at least 31 points and 5,5,5 at Higher Level at first sitting.
Repeated Scottish S6 requires at least BC in Advanced Higher Biology and Chemistry at first sitting.
resits.notes: Incomplete resit histories require manual review.

accepted_equivalents: GCSE or iGCSE English Language grade 6/B as a first-language qualification
A-level or AS English Language or Literature grade B
Cambridge C1 Advanced 195 overall and 190 each
TOEFL 105 overall with published component minimums
english_language.notes: Listed equivalents must be verified in applicant evidence.

age_or_professional_checks.fitness_to_practise_details: Separate policy not captured in the supplied research.
age_or_professional_checks.dbs_and_occupational_health: Separate official pages exist; detailed content was not extracted.

score_components.calculation_method: Best six GCSE grades; exact official tariff unpublished.
score_components.notes: Estimate mode uses a third-party linear tariff and labels it unofficial.

score_components.calculation_method: UCAT cognitive total converted to decile; exact official points tariff unpublished.
score_components.notes: Estimate mode uses national UCAT deciles and a third-party tariff.

score_components.calculation_method: Bands 1-3 scored; exact official points tariff unpublished. Band 4 is rejected.
score_components.notes: Estimate mode assumes 15, 10 and 5 points for Bands 1, 2 and 3.

score_components.calculation_method: Up to 15 official framework points; exact official per-criterion tariff unpublished.
score_components.notes: The estimate tariff is HYMS-specific, unofficial, and restricted to Home UK school-leavers without prior university study.

total_score.calculation_method: GCSE + UCAT decile + SJT + applicable contextual points.
total_score.notes: Only component maxima and the total framework are official. ApplySmart's exact score is an unofficial estimate.

calculation.notes: Applicants are ranked numerically and the interview cut-off changes with each cohort.

stage_2_interview_selection.notes: HYMS publishes no fixed current cut-off and no exact points tariff. All numerical recommendations are explicitly unofficial estimates.

criteria: First in family to attend university
School below national-average Progress 8 or devolved-nation equivalent
Completion of a recognised widening-participation programme

adjustments.effect: Up to 15 additional points; exact tariff unpublished.
Eligible applicants may be fast-tracked with UCAT decile 4+, or decile 5+ for specified routes.
Reduced AAB or alternative ABB offer conditions may apply after interview.

contextual_admissions.notes: Official contextual eligibility is separate from ApplySmart's unofficial estimate tariff and always remains subject to HYMS verification.

ranking_pools.name: A100 programme cohort
ranking_pools.notes: HYMS does not explicitly publish separate pre-interview Home, International or Graduate ranking pools.

quotas.name: Verified Home/International places (2027 entry)
quotas.notes: Home/International place figures verified by the ApplySmart admissions research team for 2027 entry.
HYMS states that up to 11 international places are available each year.

offer_selection.offer_model: Interview performance is ranked with applicable contextual consideration. Stored for research context only.
offer_selection.waiting_list_policy: Not published in the supplied research.
offer_selection.contextual_offer: Reduced AAB or alternative ABB subject to the published contextual and programme conditions.
offer_selection.notes: Offer prediction is out of scope and no post-interview outcome is produced.

historical_admissions.notes: The estimate-mode recommendation bands rely on explicitly unofficial third-party assumptions. Official or attributable FOI pool-specific cut-offs remain an evidence gap.

engine_assumptions: National UCAT deciles from the shared official UCAT dataset are used as an estimate input.
The supplied third-party component tariffs and recommendation bands are directional estimates.
Contextual estimate points are available only to Home UK school-leavers without graduate or prior-university status.
do_not_infer: Do not describe any estimated score as HYMS-published or official.
Do not present estimate bands as current HYMS cut-offs, probabilities or guarantees.
Do not award contextual estimate points to international, graduate or prior-university applicants.
Do not infer unverified international qualification equivalence.
engine_notes.approved_activation_scope: Official eligibility plus explicitly unofficial HYMS-specific estimate-mode interview guidance.
